login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with your member credentials.
login.panelBody: Projects, tracked units, custody transfers and regulatory reporting — with a full audit trail on every action.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.help: Open your authenticator app, or use one of your recovery codes.

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.requiredForRole: Your role requires two-step verification before you can continue.
enrol.intro: You will need an authenticator app (for example Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator or 1Password).
enrol.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enrol.manualKey: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:
enrol.recoveryBody: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe, apart from your password.

invite.title: Welcome to {app}
invite.intro: You have been invited as {name} ({role}). Choose a password to activate your account.
invite.rules: At least {min} characters, and it must not contain your username.
invite.invalidBody: It has expired, was already used, or was revoked. Ask an admin to send you a new invitation.

reauth.title: Confirm your password
reauth.body: This action is recorded and needs a recent confirmation. Enter your password to continue.
